description: This file implements an API client for making HTTP requests, handling JSON encoding/decoding, and managing API exceptions. It provides methods for GET, POST, PUT, and DELETE operations with token-based authorization support.

classes.name: ApiException
classes.description: Custom exception class for API errors, capturing message, status code, and response body.

classes.name: ApiClient
classes.description: Main class that handles construction and execution of HTTP requests with support for authorization tokens and JSON payloads.

methods.name: ApiClient
methods.description: Constructor initializing the API client with base URL, token provider, and optional HTTP client.

methods.name: _uri
methods.description: Constructs a complete URI from a path and optional query parameters.

methods.name: _headers
methods.description: Generates HTTP headers, including authorization if token is available, and content type for JSON.

methods.name: getJson
methods.description: Performs a GET request expecting a JSON response and decoding it into a Map.

methods.name: postJson
methods.description: Performs a POST request with a JSON body and decodes the JSON response.

methods.name: putJson
methods.description: Performs a PUT request with a JSON body and decodes the JSON response.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Performs a DELETE request, throws an exception if response indicates failure.

methods.name: _decodeOrThrow
methods.description: Decodes the JSON response, throwing an ApiException for HTTP error statuses.
